reply.shortGloss: to eat; to have a meal
reply.emotion: content and relaxed, enjoying a good meal
notes: Used broadly both for the general act of eating and for having specific meals like lunch.

senses.definition: Ingerir alimento sólido por la boca.

examples.text: Me gusta comer fruta fresca por la mañana.
examples.translation: I like to eat fresh fruit in the morning.
examples.emotion: cheerful and healthy, starting the day well

senses.definition: Tomar el almuerzo o la comida principal del mediodía.

examples.text: Vamos a comer en un restaurante cerca de aquí.
examples.translation: We are going to have lunch at a restaurant near here.
examples.emotion: hungry and looking forward to a nice break
